articles.title: Multiple NGINX Flaws Let Remote Attackers Crash Servers and Execute Malicious Code
articles.summary:
F5 has disclosed three serious security flaws in NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source that can let remote, unauthenticated attackers crash worker processes by sending crafted HTTP requests. In certain setups, the memory errors could also allow code execution, although F5 says that outcome requires Address Space Layout Randomization, known as ASLR, to be disabled […]

articles.title: 24 Security Vulnerabilities Patched in curl Used Across 30 Billion Installations
articles.summary:
The curl project released curl 8.23.0 on October 14, 2026, announcing 24 security fixes affecting the widely used data transfer tool and its underlying library, libcurl. The vulnerabilities include credential leaks, authentication errors, command injection, and flaws that can disrupt applications. The release also removes SMB and SMBS protocol support, making compatibility checks important before […]

articles.title: How MSSPs Can Cut Tier 1 Bottlenecks Eating into Profit Margins
articles.summary:
As MSSPs take on more clients, alert volumes grow fast. Analyst capacity usually doesn’t. That gap shows up in triage and response first. Teams spend too much time checking IOCs, switching between tools, rebuilding context, and escalating cases that could have been closed earlier. Across thousands of investigations, those extra minutes turn into slower response, more […]

articles.title: Microsoft’s Recent Windows Updates Break Remote Desktop Services With Error “0xC000000D”
articles.summary:
Microsoft has confirmed a Windows 11 Remote Desktop issue that can prevent non-admin users from connecting to remote computers with Administrator protection enabled. The problem follows the September 22, 2026, non-security preview update, KB5124010, or later updates. It mainly affects company-managed computers used as Remote Desktop hosts. articles.title: Hackers Use Fake WatchGuard VPN Download Site to Steal Login Credentials
articles.summary:

articles.summary:

articles.title: VirusTotal Integrates Threat Intelligence With ChatGPT for Malware Analysis
articles.summary:
VirusTotal can now bring threat intelligence into ChatGPT through VirusTotal AI (VTAI), allowing users to investigate suspicious files, URLs, domains, and IP addresses within a conversation. The connection helps analysts retrieve existing reports and explain detection results while keeping the source, analysis date, and coverage visible. articles.summary:
